description: This file defines a CKEditor 5 plugin class 'DrupalElementStyleEditing' that manages custom styles for Drupal media elements, including style definitions, conversion setup, and command registration.

classes.name: DrupalElementStyleEditing
classes.description: CKEditor 5 plugin class for managing Drupal media element styles, including initialization, style configuration normalization, and conversion setup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, normalizes style configurations, sets up conversion, and registers the 'drupalElementStyle' command.

methods.name: _setupConversion
methods.description: Configures model-to-view and view-to-model conversion for Drupal element styles, extending schema and setting up dispatchers.
